$CHMCMQuestErrorMsg: Convenient 马匹s main quest is not running.\n\nIt is recommended that you exit all menus and start it via console (StartQuest CH) before proceeding with configuration.
$CHMCMTxtCameraFix: 骑乘战斗镜头自动校正
$CHMCMTxtEquipmentMinVW: - Minimum 金币 Per 重量
$CHMCMInfoControlModeBK: Bound Key Mode: Use defined keys for each of the following features (Talk/Loot, 采集, 快速 Dis上马, 物品栏 and Follow Toggle). Multi Tap mode will be forced if SKSE not found.
$CHMCMInfoControlModeMT: Multi Tap Mode: Target 马匹 and press [Activate] button specific number of times (Single Tap - Mount/Dis上马, Dis上马ed Double Tap - 物品栏, Dis上马ed Triple Tap - Follow Toggle, Mounted Multi Tap - Talk/Loot/采集).
$CHMCMInfoFactionRelationsMode: Friendly (mod 默认) - 马匹 will neither attack nor get attacked by anyone who is a member of any known faction.\nNeutral (game 默认) - 马匹 becomes a valid target for aggressive actors and might participate in combat.
$CHMCMInfoFactionRelationsUpdate: Once updated, faction relations are saved with the game.\n阵营s relations are 自动 queued for an update if supported mod or DLC containing new factions is detected.
$CHMCMInfoConfigPower: 是否 display old configuration power in magic menu. If left hidden it will be 自动 shown once game is loaded without MCM capabilities.
$CHMCMInfoLearnWhistleOverride: Suspends the 马匹 whistle learning quest and grants the 马匹 whistle power.\nDoes not have effect if 马匹 whistle power has already been obtained by completing the quest.
$CHMCMInfoScriptLatency: Measure script latency as you play and display notification every few seconds. Ideally latency should stay around 50 ms and never go above 100 ms. Wrong results caused by menu mode should be ignored.
$CHMCMInfoInventoryRecovery: If queued for recovery any items stored in 马匹 物品栏 will be 自动 trasnfered to the 玩家 when configuration is closed.
$CHMCMInfoInventoryWeightLimit: 马匹 物品栏 storage limit will not prevent from using quick transfer functions or directly stashing items via advanced auto loot. Browsing limited 物品栏 will preserve but not show item ownership.\nSet to 0 for unlimited storage.
$CHMCMInfoAnimations: 启用或禁用 马匹 whistle and follow toggle animations.
$CHMCMInfoCameraFix: 启用或禁用 骑乘战斗 马匹 camera position auto correction. Camera bug occurs when follower 上马s the 马匹 or sheathes the weapon after 骑乘战斗 because game does not make difference between 玩家 and NPCs both triggering same animation events.
$CHMCMInfoHorseTracking: 启用 to prevent 马匹 from being moved on fast travel. This feature also prevents game from keeping track of 玩家's last ridden 马匹 when 下马ed which in turn might affect mods that rely on game's 马匹 tracking system. Does not apply to summoned 马匹s.
$CHMCMInfoMTDelay: Time to wait before interpreting the number of [Activate] button taps in Multi Tap Mode. Lower number gives faster response time at cost of accuracy. Higher number gives more accuracy at cost of response time.
$CHMCMInfoMTCombatOverride: 启用 to bypass multi-tap processing while in combat to maximize 上马/下马 response time.
$CHMCMInfoMTDismountMode: When should fast 下马ing be used instead of a standard 下马ing.
$CHMCMInfoBKInventoryLocal: Local: Restrict 物品栏 access so it can be opened only when near the 马匹.
$CHMCMInfoBKInventoryTravel: Travel: If not near the 马匹 you can hold down 物品栏 key to fast travel to the 马匹, open 物品栏 and then travel back to initial position. Travel access can only be used from rideable zones, major cities, shops, 玩家 houses, guild houses, castles and inns.
$CHMCMInfoBKInventoryRemote: Remote: Gives instant 物品栏 access regardless of 距离. Remote access can only be used from rideable zones, major cities, shops, 玩家 houses, guild houses, castles and inns.
$CHMCMInfoBKInventoryAbsolute: Absolute: Gives instant 物品栏 access regardless of all conditions.
$CHMCMInfoBKConsolidate: 是否 use Talk/Loot key to perform harvesting if no actors have been found.
$CHMCMInfoBKKeyTalk: 使用的按键 to talk to people or loot dead bodies from a 马匹back.\nUnbind the key by restoring to 默认.
$CHMCMInfoBKKeyHarvest: 使用的按键 to harvest ingredients from a 马匹back.\nUnbind the key by restoring to 默认.
$CHMCMInfoBKKeyDismount: 使用的按键 to fast 下马.\nUnbind the key by restoring to 默认.
$CHMCMInfoBKKeyInventory: 使用的按键 for 马匹 物品栏 access.\nUnbind the key by restoring to 默认.
$CHMCMInfoBKKeySpecial: 使用的按键 to toggle 马匹 follow.\nUnbind the key by restoring to 默认.
$CHMCMInfoHorseEquipmentMode: 护甲ed 马匹s do not have any additional protection (cosmetic feature) and equipment is 自动 transferred when switching to a new 马匹.
$CHMCMInfoBonusHealth: Increase 生命值 of 玩家's current 马匹. Does not apply to summoned 马匹s.
$CHMCMInfoBonusStamina: Increase 耐力 of 玩家's current 马匹. Does not apply to summoned 马匹s.
$CHMCMInfoBonusSpeed: Increase movement 速度 of 玩家's current 马匹 and all 随从' 马匹s. Also applies to summoned 马匹s.
$CHMCMInfoHorseProtOff: 玩家当前的马 is vulnerable and may die.
$CHMCMInfoHorseProtEssential: 玩家当前的马 is essential and cannot die when its 生命值 is depleted.
$CHMCMInfoHorseProtInvulnerable: 玩家当前的马 is invulnerable and does not lose 生命值 or 耐力, allowing it to sprint indefinitely.
$CHMCMInfoBehaviorCowardly: Cowardly 马匹 will run away from threats. Best paired with faction relations set to Friendly. Behavior changes apply only to 玩家's current 马匹 excluding summoned 马匹s.
$CHMCMInfoBehaviorFoolhardy: Foolhardy 马匹 will always fight back and deal more 伤害 than usual. Best paired with faction relations set to Neutral. Behavior changes apply only to 玩家's current 马匹 excluding summoned 马匹s.
$CHMCMInfoHorseFollow: 启用或禁用 马匹s following their owners. Can also be toggled in game with related controls. Does not apply to summoned 马匹s.
$CHMCMInfoHorseFollowMode: Smart follow will cause 马匹s to stop following temporarily if 玩家 is sneaking or in certain locations.
$CHMCMInfoHorseFollowDist: 玩家's 马匹 will try to maintain specific 距离 when following.\n1 foot = 21.3 game units or 0.3 meters.
$CHMCMInfoFormation: 随从 will form a delta formation with the 玩家 after using group 马匹 Call.
$CHMCMInfoScreenFade: Screen will fade to black for few seconds to hide teleportation effects when using 马匹 Call.
$CHMCMInfoFollowersHorses: Convenient 马匹s can provide 随从 with their own 马匹s and control their riding behavior.\nSupported follower mods: Extensible 随从 Framework, Ultimate 随从 Overhaul and Amazing 随从 Tweaks. Maximum 15 马匹s.
$CHMCMInfoPreferRiding: 随从 will ride even if 玩家 is not riding. Can also be toggled by talking to any of the 随从.
$CHMCMInfoAutoRetaliate: 随从 will engage in combat even if 玩家 is riding with weapons sheathed and will not break from combat until it completes.
$CHMCMInfoCombatEscape: 随从 will break from combat and 上马 the 马匹 if 玩家 is riding with weapons sheathed.
$CHMCMInfoDeferredDismount: If 启用, 随从 will not 下马 until 玩家 leaves defer zone or defer time runs out.\nUseful when 下马ing to interact with the environment and want 随从 to stay 上马ed.\nDoes not work in combat.
$CHMCMInfoDeferRadius: 设置距离 玩家 needs to move away after 下马ing before 随从 decide to 下马 themselves.\n1 foot = 21.3 game units or 0.3 meters.
$CHMCMInfoDeferTime: 设置时长 should 随从 wait for 玩家 to leave defer zone before 下马ing.\nSet to 0 to wait indefinitely.
$CHMCMInfoHorseRecall: 随从' 马匹s will be recalled (teleported out of existence) when not being ridden and 随从 will always use 马匹 Call when they want to ride.
$CHMCMInfoCallDist: 随从 will use 马匹 Call if 马匹s are past the certain 距离 threshold, otherwise 随从 will normally run toward their 马匹s to 上马 them.\n1 foot = 21.3 game units or 0.3 meters.
$CHMCMInfoMountedCombat: Allows 随从 to engage in melee 骑乘战斗. 武器s are auto-provided for the duration.
$CHMCMInfoMCdamage: 伤害 is scaled with 玩家 level and takes into account follower's related weapon skills, skill enchants and buffs. You may control the final 伤害 percentage.
$CHMCMInfoSkinSelection: 是否 use global skin for all 随从' 马匹s or set individually by talking to each follower.
$CHMCMInfoGlobalSkin: All 随从' 马匹s will be of selected type.
$CHMCMInfoEquipmentSelection: 是否 use global equipment for all 随从' 马匹s or set individually by talking to each follower.
$CHMCMInfoGlobalEquipment: All 随从' 马匹s will be equipped with selected item.
$CHMCMInfoDynamicSpeed: Dynamic 速度 scales 随从' riding 速度 with 距离 allowing them to catch up with the 玩家 more easily.\n速度 starts to increase when 1200 game units away from the 玩家 with formula:\n(距离-1200)^0.5 resulting in 速度 percentage (e.g. if 距离=3700 then 随从 ride 50% faster).
$CHMCMInfoAutoLoot: Slain enemies will have their 物品栏 opened 自动 (Basic) or specific items looted according to defined rules (Advanced). 金币 and lockpicks will always be looted in advanced mode.\nAuto loot works only in 骑乘战斗 with maximum range of 100 feet.
$CHMCMInfoIngredients: 包括所有 alchemical ingredients.\n可忽略、拾取，或直接存入马匹物品栏。\n物品存入后，通知中会显示星号。
$CHMCMInfoHides: 包括所有 tanning materials.\n可忽略、拾取，或直接存入马匹物品栏。\n物品存入后，通知中会显示星号。
$CHMCMInfoIngots: 包括所有 ore and ingots.\n可忽略、拾取，或直接存入马匹物品栏。\n物品存入后，通知中会显示星号。
$CHMCMInfoPotions: 包括所有 beneficial potions.\n可忽略、拾取，或直接存入马匹物品栏。\n物品存入后，通知中会显示星号。
$CHMCMInfoPoisons: 包括所有 poisons.\n可忽略、拾取，或直接存入马匹物品栏。\n物品存入后，通知中会显示星号。
$CHMCMInfoSpellTomes: 包括所有 spell tomes.\n可忽略、拾取，或直接存入马匹物品栏。\n物品存入后，通知中会显示星号。
$CHMCMInfoSpellTomesUnknownOnly: If 启用, only spell tomes that teach unknown spells will be included.
$CHMCMInfoBooks: 包括所有 books.\n可忽略、拾取，或直接存入马匹物品栏。\n物品存入后，通知中会显示星号。
$CHMCMInfoBooksMinValue: Books cheaper than this value will be ignored.\nBooks that teach skills usually have cost of 50 gold or more.
$CHMCMInfoLight: 包括所有 carriable light sources.\n可忽略、拾取，或直接存入马匹物品栏。\n物品存入后，通知中会显示星号。
$CHMCMInfoFood: 包括所有 meat, food and beverage.\n可忽略、拾取，或直接存入马匹物品栏。\n物品存入后，通知中会显示星号。
$CHMCMInfoRecipes: 包括所有 alchemy recipes that are not currently owned.\n可忽略、拾取，或直接存入马匹物品栏。\n物品存入后，通知中会显示星号。
$CHMCMInfoScrolls: 包括所有 magical scrolls.\n可忽略、拾取，或直接存入马匹物品栏。\n物品存入后，通知中会显示星号。
$CHMCMInfoSoulGems: 包括所有 empty and filled soul gems.\n可忽略、拾取，或直接存入马匹物品栏。\n物品存入后，通知中会显示星号。
$CHMCMInfoJewels: 包括所有 jewels.\n可忽略、拾取，或直接存入马匹物品栏。\n物品存入后，通知中会显示星号。
$CHMCMInfoKeys: 包括所有 keys that are not currently owned.\n可忽略、拾取，或直接存入马匹物品栏。\n物品存入后，通知中会显示星号。
$CHMCMInfoAmmo: 包括所有 arrows and bolts.\n可忽略、拾取，或直接存入马匹物品栏。\n物品存入后，通知中会显示星号。
$CHMCMInfoEquipment: 包括所有 armor, clothing, jewelry and weapons.\n可忽略、拾取，或直接存入马匹物品栏。\n物品存入后，通知中会显示星号。
$CHMCMInfoEquipmentEnchOnly: If 启用, only magical equipment will be included.
$CHMCMInfoEquipmentMinVW: Equipment with value to weight ratio lower than this will be ignored.\nFor example if item has 10 weight and costs 250 gold it will only be included if this value is set to 25 or lower.
$CHMCMInfoHorseCharge: 启用或禁用 骑乘战斗 马匹 charge feature.\nSprinting while in 骑乘战斗 will allow 马匹 to knock targets it runs into.
$CHMCMInfoHCImpactPrecog: 马匹 charge collision calculations do not run in sync with frame rates but it is possible to precognize the moment of impact and execute hit event prematurely. Decrease if targets are being hit by invisible wall. Increase if hit is never occuring or is being delayed.
$CHMCMInfoHCDamageBase: Fixed a上马 of physical 伤害 before other modifiers.\nKnocking targets with 马匹 charge is not considered an assault if total 伤害 is zero.
$CHMCMInfoHCDamagePercent: Physical 伤害 as a percentage of target's maximum 生命值 before other modifiers.\nKnocking targets with 马匹 charge is not considered an assault if total 伤害 is zero.
$CHMCMInfoHCStaminaCost: For each target struck 马匹 loses a percentage of its maximum 耐力.
$CHMCMInfoHCSFXMode: Switch between available impact sound effects.
$CHMCMInfoHCLoadPreset: Load predefined set of physics simulator parameters.
$CHMCMInfoHCAngleTolerance: Ignore target if angle between 马匹 heading direction and target is greater than this value.
$CHMCMInfoHCForceDissipation: Linear loss of the force over the angle of tolerance. If set to zero, force is at its maximum in all directions.\nIf greater than zero, magnitude of push force, 伤害, 耐力 cost and 速度 penalty is reduced up to this a上马 depending on the heading angle at the moment of impact.
$CHMCMInfoHCPushForce: Push force is scaled with 马匹 速度.\nBy changing this value you can control the a上马 of force that is used to push targets away.
$CHMCMInfoHCElevationAngle: Controls vertical angle of attack.\nIncrease to send targets flying or reduce to make them slide over the ground.
$CHMCMInfoHCSlowTime: Simulate recoil by slowing the 马匹 temporarily at the moment of collision.
$CHMCMInfoHCSlowPercent: How much to reduce 马匹 速度 on a per target basis.
